title: Palermo Noir gallery: the characters and art of the mafia party game
description: The cast and the art of Palermo Noir, the hidden-role party game for phones and a TV: every role card and the scenes of a night in 1950s Palermo, drawn in gold on navy.

social.title: Gallery · Palermo Noir
social.description: Every role card and the scenes of a night in Palermo, drawn in gold engraved lines on navy.
social.imageAlt: Palermo Noir: a man in a fedora stands at the seafront railings of Palermo at night, a black cat beside him, looking over the moonlit sea, drawn in gold lines on navy, beside the Palermo Noir logo

sections.title: The characters
sections.intro: Every role in the deck, as its card shows it. Click a card to see it large, then zoom in on the engraving.

items.title: Known Killer
items.alt: The Known Killer's card: a man in a dark overcoat and a fedora lights a match, a rose pinned to his lapel

items.title: Hidden Killer
items.alt: The Hidden Killer's card: a slim figure in a long coat, a fedora pulled low over the face, a rose on the lapel

items.title: Police Officer
items.alt: The Police Officer's card: an officer in a peaked cap and a buttoned uniform, writing in a notebook

items.title: Doctor

sections.title: The scenes
sections.intro: One night in Palermo, from the deal to the verdict, and the key art.

items.title: The key art
items.alt: A man in a fedora and a long coat stands at the wrought-iron railings of Palermo's seafront at night, a black cat on the rail beside him, looking over the moonlit sea towards the lamplit promenade, the palms, the cathedral dome and the dark mountain, drawn in gold engraved lines on dark navy

items.title: The deal
items.alt: Six players lean over a café table in a Palermo piazza at night: role cards dealt face down, a candle, an espresso, a black rose and a ballot box, the known killer lighting a match, the doctor, the police officer, the mayor, the lawyer and the madman with his mask, drawn in gold engraved lines on navy

items.title: The night
items.alt: A man in a fedora lights a match on a rooftop terrace above the sleeping city of Palermo: domes, bell towers and a thousand windows down to the harbour, the moon behind thin clouds, a cat on a chimney, in gold engraved lines on navy

items.title: The day
items.alt: Six suspects stand apart around a lit street lamp in a Palermo piazza at midnight, eyeing each other: the man lighting a match, the doctor, the police officer, the madman on the fountain, the mayor and the lawyer, a black rose on a playing card on the cobbles

items.title: The verdict
items.alt: A shaft of light falls on an empty chair with a black rose on its seat in the middle of a Palermo piazza at night, the six characters standing around it between two lit street lamps, the cathedral behind like a stage set
